_: Canonical cfPipelineStageBd data, pulled live 2026-09-19. Reschedule Pending retired 2026-09-17; families added 2026-09-19 for the Accounts view; the three Active Requirement Call stages added 2026-09-19. Edit ONLY here, then run: node scripts/gen-stages.mjs
note: id is what a write sends — Kylas sets a picklist by id, not by code. rung is the funnel position, 26 = furthest along. callOrder = 27 - rung. ACTIVE_REQUIREMENT_CALL_DONE_–_AWAITING_CLIENT_INPUTS contains an EN-DASH (–, U+2013), not a hyphen — that is what Kylas returns, and anything matching this code by regex, slug, filename or unquoted object key needs the exact character.

stages.label: Active Requirement Call Done – Awaiting Client Inputs
Discovery Call Done - Awaiting Client Inputs

milestonesNote: Each milestone is a FLOOR on the ladder: every stage at that rung or above counts. Because KPI Rank only ever rises, 'ever reached X' and 'is at or past X' are the same question, so a floor needs no member list. Until 2026-09-19 Kylas had one meeting track, so SQL Meeting Booked and Done floored on Discovery Call Booked and Closing Loops - Low Value as stand-ins. The Active Requirement Call stages are the real thing and the floors now name them. Closing Loops - Low Value stays at rung 21 on purpose: Ayush, 2026-09-19 — it can follow EITHER meeting, so its rung cannot say which. A company that reached Active Requirement Call Done and then closed keeps that rank because KPI Rank never falls; one that closed before any Active Requirement call correctly does not count.

engaged.label: Engaged
engaged.note: Activation and above. From here on the account is a live conversation, so a next call date and an offsite timeline stop being optional - Ayush, 2026-09-19: 'whenever someone selects a stage at or above Activation, Next Call Date must be filled... otherwise we cannot properly fix the next follow-up'. Exit stages are excluded at the call site: Closing Loops and Not Interested sit above this floor and nobody is calling them back.

retiredNote: A stage removed from the Kylas pipeline. It stays declared here because the live Airtable base still HOLDS it: rows carry its code, and rows above its rung carry rank numbers from the old numbering. wasRung is the rung it occupied, which is enough to reconstruct the old ladder exactly and derive the rank remap — see scripts/migrate-ladder.mjs. mapTo is where a record still sitting on it should go: DOWN to the rung below, never up. Mapping Reschedule Pending up to Closing Loops would claim a meeting was held and would silently promote every one of those contacts past the SQL Meeting Done floor.

retired.label: Reschedule Pending
retired.why: Removed from the Kylas pipeline. A contact waiting to reschedule got as far as a discovery call that did not happen, which is what Discovery Call No-Show (GHOSTED) already records.

familyNote: A family is how a human groups the pipeline when scanning it: what have I not touched, what am I failing to reach, what am I actually talking to, what is qualified, what is alive but not now, what is finished. The reference design guessed these from the stage NAME with regular expressions, which is fine for sample data and wrong here — we know every stage, so every stage is placed by hand. A stage missing from this map is an error the generator refuses, not an 'Other' bucket: a stage nobody classified is a stage nobody has thought about, and it would sit in a pile labelled Other for ever.

families.label: Trying to connect
families.hint: calls going out, no real conversation

addedNote: A stage ADDED to the Kylas pipeline after the live base was numbered. Declared for the same reason a retired one is: the base still holds rank numbers from the ladder that existed BEFORE it. Without this list gen-stages.mjs reconstructs the old ladder from the CURRENT stages and derives a remap for a ladder that never existed — every rank below the insertion maps to itself, so nothing is emitted, and the rank that actually moved is never remapped. addedOn also feeds the migration key, so a ladder change caused by an addition produces a key that has not run yet instead of inheriting the last retirement's.

added.why: Kylas gained a second meeting track. Discovery Call is rungs 19-22; Active Requirement Call is the SQL meeting.
